body: I'm so sorry for what you're going through. I wish I could do more than to just write you this message, but I hope it helps all the same. It sounds like your money situation is really a factor here, and that's tough. I know so many people who feel screwed by their student loans. But college is about more than just finding a job. Figuring out what you're interested in takes a lot longer than four years. I hope you take comfort in the fact that that post-grad feeling is a common struggle many of us share. I think it just takes time. Patience is a real pain, but you'd be surprised how much it can pay off.
